title: How to Get the Best Price for Your South Tampa Home
topic: How to get the best price for your South Tampa home
gbp_post:
Most South Tampa sellers focus on the number they want. The market only cares about the number it supports. Those two figures are not always the same, and the gap between them is where money gets lost.

Homes on Davis Islands that are priced within two percent of their adjusted market value go under contract faster and, counterintuitively, closer to asking than homes priced above it. The same pattern holds in Palma Ceia and along the Hyde Park streets. Overpricing does not create negotiating room. It creates days on market, and days on market create doubt in buyers who assume something is wrong.

Condition is the other variable sellers underestimate. Fresh interior paint, clean landscaping, and a pre-listing inspection that surfaces small issues before they become negotiation leverage — these details move the final number more than a granite countertop upgrade that cost twice as much.

Timing matters too. South Tampa inventory thins in late fall, which shifts leverage toward sellers who price correctly from day one rather than chasing the market down.

The sellers who net the most are almost always the ones who did the quiet, unglamorous work before the sign went in the yard.
